Rand did not move them backward in time. The original text of this article said forward, and that is correct. Either they moved forward in time (unlikely) or the trip itself took 4 months, but they definately did not move backward in time.[[User:Joedmd|Joedmd]] 20:31, February 2, 2011 (UTC)
